verdicts.reason: A breaks the hierarchy and reading order. The headline '15% off every bag' is shrunk to a small single line, and the badge is now the dominant element. The 'SUBSCRIBE & SAVE' eyebrow has moved below its headline and sits beside the CTA as a stray label. The fine print floats between the headline and the button. The top and bottom thirds of the canvas are empty. B keeps the original's stack (eyebrow, two-line headline, prominent CTA, badge on the right, fine print below) at readable sizes. Its flaws are minor: a slightly large empty band between the CTA and the fine print, and a badge that sits a little high and small next to the copy.
